meta.title: Awesome Self-Hosted Newsletter
meta.tagline: Curated, link-verified tools for running your own newsletter, mailing list and sending stack.
meta.intro: Renting an audience from a newsletter SaaS means renting the list, the deliverability and the price. This list indexes the tooling to own that stack instead: newsletter platforms and list managers, the mail servers and sending APIs underneath them, RSS-to-email automation, email authoring frameworks, and the forms and marketing automation that feed a list. Every link is checked to be live when this README is regenerated.
meta.disclaimer: Compiled from public sources — no independent testing of the linked projects.

sections.title: Newsletter Platforms and List Managers
sections.description: The applications you actually log into: write a campaign, manage subscribers, send it.

items.what: Independent publishing platform with memberships, subscriptions and built-in newsletters.

items.name: listmonk

items.name: BillionMail
items.what: Open-source mail server, newsletter and email marketing stack, fully self-hosted.

items.name: mailtrain
items.what: Self hosted newsletter app.

items.name: notifuse
items.what: Open-source, self-hosted newsletter, email marketing and transactional email platform.

items.name: keila

items.name: sendportal
items.what: Open-source self-hosted email marketing for managing your own newsletters at lower cost.

items.name: phplist3

sections.title: Sending Infrastructure and Mail Servers
sections.description: What sits under the newsletter: the MTA, the delivery platform and the transactional API.

items.name: docker-mailserver
items.what: Production-ready fullstack mail server (SMTP, IMAP, LDAP, antispam, antivirus) in a container.

items.name: postal
items.what: A fully featured open source mail delivery platform for incoming and outgoing e-mail.

items.name: stalwart
items.what: All-in-one mail and collaboration server fluent in IMAP, JMAP, SMTP, CalDAV and CardDAV.

items.name: mailcow-dockerized
items.what: A Docker-based mail server suite bundling the full mail stack.

items.name: Mailu
items.what: Insular email distribution — a mail server shipped as Docker images.

items.name: mox
items.what: Modern full-featured open source secure mail server for low-maintenance self-hosted email.

items.name: cuttlefish
items.what: Transactional email server with a web interface.

items.name: relay
items.what: Open-source email API for developers, a cloud and self-hosted alternative to SES, Mailgun and SendGrid.

sections.title: RSS to Newsletter and Email Authoring
sections.description: Turning sources into issues: feed-to-email automation and the markup that makes email render.

items.name: RSSHub
items.what: Everything is RSSible — generates RSS feeds from many sources that have none.

items.name: MJML
items.what: A markup framework that makes writing responsive email less painful.

items.name: rss2email
items.what: Forward RSS feeds to your email address, community maintained.

items.name: rss2newsletter

items.name: Elements
items.what: React components for transactional emails, landing pages, invoices and PDFs.

items.name: listmonk-rss
items.what: Provides an RSS integration for listmonk, the self-hosted newsletter and mailing list manager.
